description: Step 9 of docs/the-delivery-loop.md: a validated trunk accepted and released. The mandate is one JSON object naming the repo and the version, with base and forge_repo optional. The tree must stand, clean, on the remote trunk, because the release builds from HEAD. The notes are the CHANGELOG.md section for the version at that commit, and with no such section the run stops before anything is built. `sailor release sailor` builds and installs the candidate, the installed binary must name the version, and a person walks the acceptance journey on that binary and binds the walk to the candidate commit; the journey runs whatever the release policy says. Only then is the policy read from the trusted trunk, with `ask` on release or push handing the tag to a person; the trunk is re-read, the publication gate runs on the candidate and on the notes, and the tag is created and pushed. The run is complete only when the host reports a published, non-draft release for that tag. Every forge call runs as the account in sailor.forgeAs.

with.command:
set -eu
git -C "$REPO" fetch --quiet --tags origin
candidate=$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse --verify "refs/remotes/origin/$BASE^{commit}")
head=$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse HEAD)
[ "$head" = "$candidate" ] || { echo "the tree stands at $head, not the remote $BASE at $candidate: the release builds from HEAD, so it would build something else" >&2; exit 1; }
[ -z "$(git -C "$REPO" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" ] || { echo "the tree carries uncommitted changes" >&2; exit 1; }
tag="v$VERSION"
if tagged=$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse --verify --quiet "refs/tags/$tag^{commit}"); then
    [ "$tagged" = "$candidate" ] || { echo "$tag already names $tagged, not the candidate $candidate" >&2; exit 1; }
fi
previous=$(git -C "$REPO" describe --tags --abbrev=0 --match 'v*' "$candidate^" 2>/dev/null || true)
printf '{"candidate":"%s","tag":"%s","previous_tag":"%s"}' "$candidate" "$tag" "$previous"

set -eu
common=$(cd "$REPO" && cd "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)" && pwd)
outgoing="$common/sailor/outgoing"
mkdir -p "$outgoing"
file="$outgoing/release-notes-$VERSION.md"
git -C "$REPO" show "$CANDIDATE:CHANGELOG.md" > "$outgoing/changelog-$VERSION.md" 2>/dev/null || { echo "the candidate carries no CHANGELOG.md: the release stops" >&2; exit 1; }
VERSION="$VERSION" FILE="$file" python3 - "$outgoing/changelog-$VERSION.md" <<'PY'
import json, os, re, sys
text = open(sys.argv[1]).read()
version = os.environ["VERSION"]
heading = re.compile(r"^## \[?v?" + re.escape(version) + r"\]?(\s.*)?$")
lines = text.splitlines()
start = next((i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if heading.match(line)), None)
if start is None:
    sys.exit("CHANGELOG.md has no section for %s: the release stops" % version)
end = next((i for i in range(start + 1, len(lines)) if lines[i].startswith("## ")), len(lines))
notes = "\n".join(lines[start + 1:end]).strip()
if not notes:
    sys.exit("the CHANGELOG.md section for %s is empty: the release stops" % version)
open(os.environ["FILE"], "w").write(notes + "\n")
print(json.dumps({"notes_file": os.environ["FILE"]}))
PY

set -eu
cd "$REPO"
said=$(sailor policy) || { echo "the delivery policy could not be resolved from the trusted trunk" >&2; exit 1; }
printf '%s\n' "$said" | python3 -c '
import json, sys
lines = [line.strip() for line in sys.stdin if line.strip()]
fields = dict(line.split(": ", 1) for line in lines[:-1])
for key in ("merge", "push", "release"):
    if fields.get(key) not in ("auto", "ask"):
        sys.exit("the policy does not say auto or ask for " + key)
print(json.dumps({
    "merge": fields["merge"], "push": fields["push"], "release": fields["release"],
    "read_from": lines[-1],
    "asks_publication": "ask" if fields["push"] == "ask" else "auto",
    "asks_integration": "ask" if "ask" in (fields["merge"], fields["push"]) else "auto",
    "asks_release": "ask" if "ask" in (fields["release"], fields["push"]) else "auto",
}))
'

$join: The delivery policy read from the trusted trunk (commit

) asks a person before this flow may put the candidate into service, walk the journey on it, tag it and publish the release. Approve with an output file holding {"authorized": true}, or reject with the reason.

options.label: authorize
options.facts: every check before this step passed on the recorded commit

options.label: refuse
options.facts: nothing outward has happened yet; the run stops here

with.command:
set -eu
printf '%s' "$SAID" | KEY="$KEY" python3 -c '
import json, os, sys
said = json.loads(sys.stdin.read())
if not isinstance(said, dict) or said.get(os.environ["KEY"]) is not True:
    sys.exit("the person did not write %s: true; nothing proceeds" % os.environ["KEY"])
print(json.dumps({"confirmed": True}))
'

set -eu
cd "$REPO"
[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$CANDIDATE" ] || { echo "the tree moved off the candidate $CANDIDATE" >&2; exit 1; }
SAILOR_SOURCES="$REPO" sailor release sailor >&2
printf '{"built_from":"%s"}' "$CANDIDATE"

set -eu
said=$(sailor version)
case "$said " in "sailor $VERSION "*) ;; *) echo "the installed binary says «${said}», not sailor ${VERSION}" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
printf '{"said":"%s"}' "$said"

$join: Walk docs/acceptance-journey.md on the binary this run just installed (it says «

), never on an older one. Record the walk outside this tree and add it to the journey's table only after the release is published: a commit to the trunk now moves it off the candidate and stops the release. Approve with an output file holding {"commit": the commit above, "green": true} only when every step is green; reject with the red steps otherwise. This step runs whatever the release policy says.

options.label: green
options.facts: every step of the journey met its expectation on the candidate

options.label: red
options.facts: a red step stops the release, whatever the suite said

with.command:
set -eu
printf '%s' "$WALK" | CANDIDATE="$CANDIDATE" python3 -c '
import json, os, sys
walk = json.loads(sys.stdin.read())
if not isinstance(walk, dict) or walk.get("commit") != os.environ["CANDIDATE"]:
    sys.exit("the journey was not walked on the candidate %s" % os.environ["CANDIDATE"])
if walk.get("green") is not True:
    sys.exit("the journey is not green")
print(json.dumps({"commit": walk["commit"], "green": True}))
'
